# Test fixtures

Bundled minimal data + recorded SNANA outputs that let the parity suite
run anywhere — no SNANA install, no `$SNDATA_ROOT` needed.

## Layout

- `data/` — minimal SIMLIB / kcor / cropped models / SEARCHEFF /
  spectrograph DATs. The top-level conftest sets
  `$JAX_TEST_FIXTURE_ROOT` to this directory so input files resolve
  `$JAX_TEST_FIXTURE_ROOT/...` paths.
- `snana/<name>/` — recorded SNANA outputs (DUMP, HEAD.FITS, PHOT.FITS)
  plus the `input.input` that produced them and a per-fixture README
  documenting SNANA version + command + date.
- `build_toy_data.py` — generates the toy assets listed in `data/README.md`;
  copied models and authored configuration inputs are separate source assets.
- `regenerate.py` — script that runs SNANA against each registered
  fixture's `input.input` and captures the outputs into `snana/<name>/`.
- `snana_version.txt` — pinned SNANA version. Live-SNANA suite fails
  loudly if `snlc_sim.exe --version` doesn't match.
- `pippin/` — a config copied from the Pippin repository, with the data
  files it names, so the Pippin reader is tested against a config someone
  else wrote. Its own README records the Pippin commit.

## Provenance

Each `snana/<name>/README.md` records the exact SNANA version, command,
and date used to generate the bundle. Re-running `regenerate.py` updates
those READMEs so provenance never drifts from the on-disk content.

## Retained data

Keep simulation input files and recorded outputs that tests consume. Fixtures
used only for input configuration or DUMP comparisons do not store HEAD/PHOT;
`head=False, phot=False` in `regenerate.py` records that choice. Fitter variants use
`sim_from` to share their simulation while retaining separate fit namelists and
SNANA reference tables.

For replay-only photometry, `replay_events` selects the first distinct DUMP
CIDs. Regeneration retains those events' complete photometry, including
end-of-event markers, and rebuilds the HEAD pointers. The full DUMP stays
available for statistical comparisons. Do not thin statistical samples or
bias-correction grids merely to reduce fixture size.

The tracked fixture payload is about 62 MB after removing unused outputs,
sharing identical fitter inputs, trimming replay photometry and compression.
Figures exclude Git history and local caches. Recorded SNANA FITS files use
lossless gzip (level 6, zero timestamp). Numerical text tables, DUMPs and
model/calibration assets of at least 100 KB also use gzip; small configuration
files and scripts stay readable. Compression preserves the complete original
file bytes. Readers accept either the plain basename or its `.gz` spelling.

`regenerate.py` compresses recorded outputs after trimming and fitting. The
BEAMS `build.py` and `refs.py` apply the same 100 KB threshold to their tables.
`python tests/fixtures/build_toy_data.py --compress` applies the asset policy
after copying verbatim models or running individual asset generators. External
SNANA reference commands receive temporary plain-text tables where their
header reader requires them.

Mostly toys (hand-crafted SIMLIB, hand-crafted GENPDF / SEARCHEFF DAT
files); one cropped-real NON1ASED template (V19 INDEX 834, sub-sampled
phase × wavelength grid → ~25 KB gzipped); one verbatim copy of the
real LSST baseline kcor FITS (~475 KB, binary multi-HDU not feasible to
hand-craft); one verbatim copy of BAYESN.W22 (the model directory is
small enough at ~76 KB to bundle as-is).

`JAX_TEST_LSST_SPECTRO.fits` is the one edited copy: its SPECTROGRAPH `LAMRES`
column was set to 0.4x the bin width. At the real value the resolution is far
finer than a bin, so SNANA's smearing kernel collapses to the identity and the
wavelength-smearing path is never exercised. `JAX_TEST_LSST_SPECTRO_NOSYN.fits`
keeps the original resolution so the identity case stays covered.

The four large `bbc_des_beams/BIASCOR_*` variants are generated by the
`bbc_biascor_variants` session fixture in a pytest temporary directory.
Their recipe is shared with `refs.py`; the independent SNANA reference
outputs remain recorded. No generated inputs are written into the checkout.
